items.exampleEn: The date of the wedding was inscribed inside the ring.
items.exampleZh: 婚禮的日期刻在戒指內側。

items.exampleEn: This bilingual dictionary is very useful.
items.glossZh: 雙語的；會說兩種語言的

items.exampleEn: People used to send telegrams for important news.
items.exampleZh: 以前人們會用電報傳遞重要消息。

items.exampleEn: The music came from a loudspeaker on the wall.
items.exampleZh: 音樂是從牆上的擴音器傳出來的。

items.exampleEn: The food blogger tried every dish on the menu.
items.exampleZh: 那位美食部落客把菜單上每道菜都吃過了。

items.exampleEn: The old bus moved noisily up the hill.
items.exampleZh: 那輛老公車轟隆隆地開上山坡。

items.exampleEn: Practice this dialog with a partner.
It takes a long time to upload big videos.
items.exampleZh: 上傳大型影片要花很久的時間。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather kept every telegram he received.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺留著他收到的每一封電報。

items.audioEn: Please don't upload photos of the concert until the band says it's OK.
items.audioZh: 在樂團說可以之前，請不要上傳演唱會的照片。
items.questionZh: 什麼時候可以上傳照片？
options: As soon as the concert begins tonight.
Only during the break between the songs.
After the band says it's OK.

items.sentenceEn: The students read the dialog aloud.
items.sentenceZh: 學生們把這段對話大聲念出來。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't eat noisily at the table.
items.sentenceZh: 吃飯時請不要發出很大的聲音。

items.stemEn: The ____ in the classroom is too loud; please turn it down.
items.stemZh: 教室裡的擴音器太大聲了，請轉小聲一點。

items.stemEn: My cousin is ____; she speaks two languages at home.
items.stemZh: 我的表親是雙語人士，她在家說兩種語言。

items.passageEn: Our school held a bilingual open day last Saturday. A loudspeaker at the gate welcomed visitors in two languages. In the history room, students showed an old telegram from 1960 and a silver cup with the school's name inscribed on it. Two students acted out a short dialog in English. A famous blogger came and uploaded photos of the day. Some little children ran noisily through the halls.
items.passageZh: 我們學校上週六舉辦了雙語開放日。大門口的擴音器用兩種語言歡迎訪客。在歷史教室裡，學生展示了一封 1960 年的舊電報，還有一個刻著校名的銀杯。兩名學生用英文演出了一段簡短的對話。一位知名的部落客來了，還上傳了當天的照片。有些小朋友吵鬧地在走廊上跑來跑去。

questions.questionZh: 大門口的擴音器做了什麼？
options: 播放了一首很長的英文歌
提醒大家不要亂丟垃圾
用兩種語言歡迎來參觀的訪客

questions.questionZh: 那位知名部落客做了什麼？
options: 在禮堂發表了一場演講

items.promptZh: 我昨晚上傳了一些旅行照片。
referenceEn: I uploaded some travel photos last night.
Last night I uploaded some photos from my trip.
rubricZh: upload 表示「上傳」，例如 upload photos 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 blogger 造一個句子，說說你喜歡的部落客。
referenceEn: My favorite blogger writes about cooking.
I follow a travel blogger who visits a new city every month.
rubricZh: blogger 表示「部落客」，可數名詞，例如 a travel blogger 等說法
說的是自己的喜好（例如 my、I）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："My aunt is a bilingual blogger who writes in two languages. Last week, she uploaded a video about her grandfather's old things. One was a telegram that he sent in 1960 to say he had arrived safely in a new city. Another was a silver watch. Her grandmother had asked a shop to inscribe his name on the back. In the video, my aunt also read a short dialog from an old radio play. Her neighbor's dog barked noisily in the background, and a loudspeaker outside announced a street market."；改後："Our school held a bilingual open day last Saturday. A loudspeaker at the gate welcomed visitors in two languages. In the history room, students showed an old telegram from 1960 and a silver cup with the school's name inscribed on it. Two students acted out a short dialog in English. A famous blogger came and uploaded photos of the day. Some little children ran noisily through the halls."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："我阿姨是一位會用兩種語言寫作的雙語部落客。上週她上傳了一支影片，介紹她爺爺的舊東西。其中一樣是一封電報，是他 1960 年寄出的，說他已經平安抵達一座新城市。另一樣是一支銀錶，她奶奶曾請店家把他的名字刻在錶的背面。在影片裡，阿姨也念了一段老廣播劇裡的簡短對話。她鄰居的狗在背景裡吵鬧地叫著，外面的擴音器還在宣布街頭市集的消息。"；改後："我們學校上週六舉辦了雙語開放日。大門口的擴音器用兩種語言歡迎訪客。在歷史教室裡，學生展示了一封 1960 年的舊電報，還有一個刻著校名的銀杯。兩名學生用英文演出了一段簡短的對話。一位知名的部落客來了，還上傳了當天的照片。有些小朋友吵鬧地在走廊上跑來跑去。"
